content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is about creating a seamless payment solution for digital products in regions where traditional platforms fail. West African creators can leverage blockchain technology to accept payments directly from customers worldwide. By removing geographic restrictions and eliminating reliance on third-party services, creators can gain full control over their sales process. This shift not only empowers creators but also opens up new revenue streams, enhancing financial independence in a region often overlooked by global payment providers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this infrastructure integrates several components: hosting through platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing through NOWPayments. Transactions using USDT on the Tron network settle in under 60 seconds for a minimal fee, ensuring quick and efficient payment processing. This architecture allows creators to manage their operations without the limitations imposed by conventional banking systems, enhancing their ability to respond to market demands.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators across West Africa, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, who are looking to sell ebooks, courses, and templates. It is especially designed for those who have faced payment rejections from conventional platforms. By using this infrastructure, creators can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, thus avoiding the pitfalls of local currency fluctuation and transaction limits imposed by traditional banking. The aim is to foster a community of empowered creators who can thrive in the digital economy.
Empower your sales with blockchain technology—no middlemen required.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The system comprises several essential components that work in tandem: a hosting platform for your online store, a backend for order processing, and a payment processor that verifies transactions through blockchain. Using tools like Supabase for order management and Google Drive for file delivery ensures that creators can maintain full ownership of their data and products. This interconnectivity not only streamlines operations but also enhances security and reliability for both creators and customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your digital commerce stack, first, choose your hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers, integrating NOWPayments for payment processing. Populate your store with products, ensuring you have clear delivery methods in place using Google Drive. Finally, promote your store through social media and community channels to attract buyers. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all blueprints and templates you need.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Instant transactions mean your customers get access to their products immediately.

For additional resources and templates, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.

Yes, creators in Pakistan can use cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This enables them to sell ebooks and other digital products directly to buyers without relying on Stripe or other conventional payment methods.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than many traditional payment platforms. This makes it an attractive option for digital creators looking to maximize their earnings.
How quickly can transactions be processed using blockchain?
Transactions using USDT on the Tron network settle in under 60 seconds, with fees typically under $0.10. This rapid processing time enhances the purchasing experience for customers.
